expected_behavior.description: Attempt to hide from enemies. On success, you become invisible to hostile creatures until you attack, cast a spell, or are detected.

notes: Self-targeted bonus action that applies 'hidden' status for 10 turns. Costs 1 bonus action. Placed 8m from hostile to ensure out of direct adjacency. Rogues get Cunning Action: Hide as a bonus action — this tests the common version which is also a bonus action.
